name: explosion-crater
comment: WP-1.8 Explosion through the explode op (World.createExplosion(null, 0.5, 61, 0.5, 4)) at t=2 over a stone floor (y 55-58) under two layers of dirt (59-60), a sand column at (5,61..63,0), an obsidian wall at x=6 (y 61-62, z -1..1), and three EntityItems: one near the centre (destroyed: EntityItem health 5), one behind the obsidian wall (partly shielded: World.getBlockDensity), one out of range. doExplosionA: 1352 rays drawing World.rand, destroyedBlockPositions in HashSet order, the entity pass (attackEntityFrom, knockback); doExplosionB: World.rand particle draws per position in reverse set order, block drops with chance 0.3 (EntityItems, Math.random), air. Afterwards the drops fall into the crater and sand left without support falls (BlockSand). rng_state every tick, entity_state at t=2 and every 5, block_box of the crater area at t=2 and t=29.
